description: The renewable-finance research team publishes observed cost-of-capital estimates for renewable energy projects across 68 countries from 2010 through 2022. The Figshare deposit contains a CSV with source-study information, locations and project-finance variables described in the repository and article. Public access is free under CC BY 4.0. The table can help set country and technology finance assumptions in capacity-planning simulations; model-pypsa-eur is a related modelling context. A caveat is that reported financing costs are assembled from studies with different methods, years and project types. One value should not be treated as a universal current lending rate for a country. Missing projects and regional reporting bias require attention before interpolation. The own metadata and file name were checked without opening rows or recomputing estimates. Figure-reproduction code exists in a separate Zenodo release and is assessed independently.
